topic: Using Standard Algorithms for Efficient Data Manipulation
explanation: The C++ Standard Template Library (STL) provides a rich set of algorithms that offer efficient and generic ways to manipulate data.  Using these algorithms promotes code readability, maintainability, and often performance improvements compared to manually written loops.  A key aspect is understanding the different algorithm categories and selecting the appropriate one for the task at hand.  Common pitfalls include misunderstanding iterator types and failing to consider algorithm preconditions (e.g., sorted ranges for algorithms like `std::lower_bound`).
keywords: STL algorithms, C++ algorithms, generic programming
